name: v0.3.86 — Ads return to the app (free tier) + mobile menu
releaseNotes:
• GetGuac Premium now removes ads everywhere — subscribe in Profile to go fully ad-free.
• Web pages opened in the app now reach Marketplace, Coupons, Resources and Calculators from a new menu (☰).
• Reliability tweaks to email rendering and the in-app updater.
